verdict.rationale: Airweave's agentic search mode is a built-in AI agent that takes a retrieval task and carries it out on its own: it iteratively searches with multiple strategies, reads full documents and navigates entity hierarchies. That is real delegation, but only for search; nothing shows a general in-product assistant that takes other tasks, and the founder describes Airweave as a developer building block. missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant beyond search, delegation of non-search tasks (e.g. managing collections or syncs via the assistant), an in-dashboard assistant UI, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: An AI agent iteratively searches your data using tool calling. It searches with multiple strategies, reads full documents, navigates entity hierarchies (parent/child/sibling), and builds a comprehensive result set.
